# cloudflare_workers_subdomain (Resource)

Accepted Permissions

- `Workers Scripts Read`
- `Workers Scripts Write`

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudflare_workers_subdomain" "example_workers_subdomain" {
  account_id = "023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353"
  subdomain  = "my-subdomain"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Identifier of the Cloudflare account.
- `subdomain` (String) Account-wide label used for workers.dev hostnames. This does not enable workers.dev or preview URLs for any individual Worker.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier for the resource. This is the account ID because the Workers subdomain is an account-wide singleton.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
$ terraform import cloudflare_workers_subdomain.example_workers_subdomain '<account_id>'
```
